title: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models

one_line: WebVoyager evaluates multimodal agents on live website browsing tasks.
WebVoyager 在真实网页浏览任务上评测多模态智能体。
why: it is a widely used live-web multimodal agent benchmark
inclusion_reason: it is a widely used live-web multimodal agent benchmark

title: Problem
问题
html:
WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models asks how to close this gap: Open-web agents face live websites, screenshots, and changing page states; simulator-only or text-only evaluations miss that multimodal uncertainty. The primary source is https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.13919; public status is ACL 2024 main / arXiv (2024).

Decision boundary: It is collected as a live-web multimodal agent benchmark and evaluation protocol, not as a deterministic programmatic verifier. The evaluation surface is a user instruction, website context, screenshot/page observation, browser action trace, final response, task date or site condition, and evaluator judgment. This makes the paper useful for the atlas because the data object and feedback rule can be audited together.

WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models 回答的问题是：开放网页智能体面对实时网站、截图和变化的页面状态；只用模拟器或文本评测会漏掉这种多模态不确定性。主来源是 https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.13919；公开状态为 ACL 2024 main / arXiv（2024）。

决策边界：它应作为 live-web 多模态智能体基准和评测协议收录，不是确定性程序验证器。评测面是：一个任务包含用户指令、网站上下文、截图/页面观察、浏览器动作轨迹、最终回复、任务日期或站点条件，以及评测判断。它对 atlas 的价值在于任务对象和反馈规则可以一起审计。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models makes a user instruction, website context, screenshot/page observation, browser action trace, final response, task date or site condition, and evaluator judgment. reusable by binding it to a concrete feedback contract.

Core mechanism: The authors build an LMM-powered browser agent and test it end-to-end on real websites via Selenium. Feedback contract: A GPT-4V-based automatic evaluator judges success from the task, responses, and recent screenshots, with optional human inspection and reported human-agreement calibration. Closest comparisons are text-only web agents, static web snapshots, and simulator-only web-agent benchmarks. Direction label: verifier-anchored agent evaluation, where the reusable unit is task object plus acceptance rule.

一句话贡献：WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models 把一个任务包含用户指令、网站上下文、截图/页面观察、浏览器动作轨迹、最终回复、任务日期或站点条件，以及评测判断。绑定到具体反馈契约，形成可复用对象。

核心机制：作者构建 LMM 驱动浏览器智能体，并通过 Selenium 在真实网站上端到端测试。反馈契约： GPT-4V 自动评测器：根据任务、回复和最近截图判断成功，并配合可选人工检查及人工一致性校准。最接近的对比对象是：文本网页智能体、静态网页快照和仅模拟器网页智能体基准。方向标签是 verifier-anchored agent evaluation，即可复用单元是任务对象加验收规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs include the task specification, environment or substrate state, context fields released with the benchmark, and the model or human action/answer surface.

  1. Compile web tasks across popular websites.
  2. Let the agent observe screenshots and interact with the browser.
  3. Collect final answers and action traces.
  4. Use GPT-4V evaluation and human checks to judge task success.

Outputs are 643 task queries across 15 websites, additional GAIA-derived browsing tasks, action traces, final answers, automatic judgments, and model success rates. The verifier, reward, judge, or environment is: A GPT-4V-based automatic evaluator judges success from the task, responses, and recent screenshots, with optional human inspection and reported human-agreement calibration. Reproduction requires pinning artifact release, split, evaluator or judge version, environment state, prompt/scaffold, action budget, and redistribution terms.

输入包括任务规格、环境或 substrate 状态、基准公开的上下文字段，以及模型或人类的动作/答案输出面。

  1. 固定任务规格、环境或页面状态，以及公开上下文字段。
  2. 让模型、人类或基准策略产生动作、答案或轨迹。
  3. 用论文定义的 verifier、reward、judge 或环境谓词评分。
  4. 保存输出、版本、split、预算和失败模式，供复现比较。

输出包括 15 个网站上的 643 个 task queries、额外 GAIA browsing tasks、动作轨迹、最终答案、自动判断和模型成功率。验证器、reward、judge 或环境是 GPT-4V 自动评测器：根据任务、回复和最近截图判断成功，并配合可选人工检查及人工一致性校准。复现时必须固定 artifact release、split、评测器或 judge 版本、环境状态、prompt/scaffold、动作预算和再发布条款。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Reported evidence: The paper reports 643 task queries across 15 websites, WebVoyager task success of 59.1%, and 85.3% agreement between the automatic metric and human judgment.

Instance-level evidence: For one task, decisive evidence is the final answer or page state being judged successful under the stated evaluator protocol. Aggregate numbers should be reused only with their evaluator version, split, budget, and environment state attached.

报告证据：论文报告 15 个网站上的 643 个 task queries，WebVoyager 任务成功率 59.1%，自动指标与人工判断一致率 85.3%。

逐实例证据：单个任务的决定性证据是最终答案或页面状态在既定评测协议下被判成功。聚合数字只有和评测器版本、split、预算、环境状态一起保留时才适合复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior-work baseline: text-only web agents, static web snapshots, and simulator-only web-agent benchmarks.

What changes: The contribution is end-to-end multimodal open-web evaluation plus a calibrated LMM-judge protocol for open-ended web tasks. The quality signal is not a high leaderboard score alone; it is the combination of a defined object, an explicit feedback contract, and artifacts that can be pinned. Before reuse, inspect license, split, evaluator stability, contamination risk, and whether examples are evaluation-only or trainable data.

已有工作基线：文本网页智能体、静态网页快照和仅模拟器网页智能体基准。

变化在于：贡献是开放网页端到端多模态评测，以及面向开放式网页任务的校准 LMM judge 协议。质量信号不是单个高榜单分数，而是定义清楚的对象、显式反馈契约和可固定版本的 artifact。复用前要检查许可证、split、评测器稳定性、污染风险，以及样本到底是 evaluation-only 还是可训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness is only relative to the stated contract: A GPT-4V-based automatic evaluator judges success from the task, responses, and recent screenshots, with optional human inspection and reported human-agreement calibration. Live sites drift, tasks can disappear, and GPT-4V-style judging inherits prompt/model bias. The 85.3% agreement figure does not guarantee reliability for every task category.

The paper should not be read as unrestricted real-world reliability. Public artifacts can become training data, service-backed environments can drift, and judge/evaluator implementations can change across releases.

正确性只相对于已声明契约成立：反馈契约是 GPT-4V 自动评测器：根据任务、回复和最近截图判断成功，并配合可选人工检查及人工一致性校准。实时网站会漂移，任务可能消失，GPT-4V 式 judge 继承 prompt/模型偏差。85.3% 一致率不保证每类任务都可靠。

不要把论文解读成无限制真实世界可靠性证明。公开 artifact 会进入后续训练语料，服务支撑环境会漂移，judge/评测器实现也可能随发布版本变化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Practical use: Use it for live-web benchmark records with website, date, screenshot, action trace, final answer, evaluator prompt/model, and human-calibration sample.

For atlas reuse, keep provenance and feedback fields: task id, source version, environment or substrate, observation fields, action or answer fields, verifier/judge output, split, budget, and known failure modes.

实际用途：可用于 live-web benchmark 记录：保留网站、日期、截图、动作轨迹、最终答案、评测器 prompt/模型和人工校准样本。

在 atlas 复用时，应保留 provenance 和反馈字段：task id、来源版本、环境或 substrate、观察字段、动作或答案字段、验证器/judge 输出、split、预算和已知失败模式。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Separate agent scaffold from benchmark evidence; the evaluation surface can be reused even when a different browser-agent architecture is tested.

Keep three labels separate while reading: evaluation surface, trainable trajectory or data object, and reward/judge/verifier contract. A released benchmark artifact is not automatically safe training data, and an aggregate score is not row-level evidence.

要分开 agent scaffold 和基准证据；即使用不同浏览器智能体架构，也可复用这个评测面。

阅读时把三类标签分开：评测面、可训练轨迹或数据对象、reward/judge/verifier 契约。公开 benchmark artifact 不自动等于安全训练数据；聚合分数也不等于逐行证据。
